messages:
mira: dropped a compact mock for the 'variant timeline legend' on the rollout panel -> https://figma.com/file/variant-legend. Idea: combine micro legend + timeline so users can decode patterns without opening a legend drawer.
kevin: nice! makes scanning faster. question: legend uses color + label; we need non-color cues for accessibility.
noor: agree. propose small glyphs (stripe/dot/wave) next to color swatch and a visible text label. For screen readers, each legend item should be a button that opens a short description via aria-live.
mira: good call. will add glyphs and make legend items focusable. aria-live text like: "Canary (v2.1) 12% traffic 1 mobile cohort" when focused.
sam: microcopy nit: change label 'Canary' -> 'Canary (experiment)' to reduce PM ambiguity. Also: legend height must compress on mobile. consider a horizontal scrollable legend or a chevron to expand.
mira: I'll make it horizontally scrollable on narrow widths, with a compact chevron to expand full list. touch targets stay >=44px.
a11y-bot: checklist: ensure legend glyphs have alt text, contrast 4.5:1 for labels, and focus order is logical (legend -> timeline -> inspector). Also ensure aria-describedby for the timeline describing legend state.
kevin: rollback affordance in mock: small inline 'revert' under each variant chip. worry about accidental taps. suggestion: action menu (kebab) with Promote / Revert / Inspect. Revert opens a modal with reason and preview.
noor: modal should be aria-modal, trap focus, and have collapsed 'Impact' section. Include a clear caption about audit/2FA when workspace==prod.
mira: I'll wire the modal: preview mini-timeline, collapsed impact (latency/cost estimates), reason dropdown, optional notify channel checkbox, and explicit primary "Confirm and rollback traffic".
sam: also add an undo snackbar after action: "Rollback completed. Undo available for 5 minutes." must be keyboard-focusable and dismissible. Announce via aria-live.
a11y-bot: final extra: keyboard shortcuts doc: Left/Right to scrub timeline, Enter to open actions, Space to toggle preview, Esc to close. Include in handoff comments.
mira: thanks. I'll update Figma with glyph legend, horizontal scroll for mobile, action menu, modal with impact preview + 2FA copy, updated confirm copy, undo snackbar, and add an accessibility checklist in the file comments. Posting updated link in ~50m. Leaving thread open for any more tiny nits.
thread_summary: Discussion on adding a compact variant timeline legend with glyphs for accessibility, horizontal scroll on mobile, focused aria-live descriptions, safer action menu for rollback with a confirm modal including collapsed impact and 2FA/audit copy, undo snackbar, and keyboard shortcut checklist.
